propositions: Code review lacks a concurrency criterion to detect data races despite four production race bugs in the repo traced to unlocked twin writes and TOCTOU patterns.
A two-tier lexical trigger (committed high-precision synchronized-primitive tokens plus project-extensible vocabulary in routing config) detects race patterns with controlled false positive rate.

The committed tier intentionally omits modal unlocked-twin races (raw git index writes, lockfile TOCTOU) and relies on project-specific vocabulary in .rebar/criteria_routing.json for recall on repo-specific patterns.
The overlay ships as advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) and integrates into the four-pass code-review gate following established overlay invariants.
Unit tests and standing eval over the corpus verify the two-tier trigger fires deterministically on sync-primitive hunks and project-routed vocabulary without false positives on non-race patterns.
